name: topo-background

frames.best_why: The cursor sits on a raised hill, so contour rings bunch tightly around it; other frames read flatter.

tagline: Faint contour lines drift and gather into rings under the cursor.
summary: A full-bleed map of thin topographic contour lines with small elevation numbers, slowly drifting across a dark stage. Moving the pointer raises a hill of tighter rings, and a click sends ripples outward through the terrain.
appearance: A near-black stage covered edge to edge with thin pale contour lines that loop into hills and hollows at uneven spacing. Tiny elevation numbers ride along some lines, and a centred white headline with a grey subline sits over the middle of the map.
behaviour: The lines drift on their own, slowly. Hovering raises a hill that slides after the pointer while the rings crowd around it, and clicking sends a fading ripple train outward. The top and bottom edges fade into the page.
demo_content: Heading "Find your footing" plus a subtitle inviting a cursor move and a click.
search_phrases: terrain lines that follow the mouse
use_when: A hero or section needs a quiet, technical backdrop that rewards pointer movement without fighting the copy.
avoid_when: It runs a drawing loop and needs a parent with real height; touch screens get no hover hill.
customise: Props set contour spacing, drift speed, pointer interactivity, terrain seed and whether elevation numbers print; pass children to replace the default headline and copy.
weight_why: Rebuilds a full contour field on a canvas about every frame; idle frames are halved.

a11y.note: Pointer hill and click ripple are mouse-only and the canvas is hidden from assistive tech; motion stops under reduced-motion.

polish_why: Crisp contour tracing and a believable cursor hill; labels are very faint at this size.
title: Topo Background
